name: automattic/newspack-workspace
description: Shared PHP dev tooling for the Newspack monorepo.

scripts.test:plugins: for d in plugins/*/phpunit.xml*; do [ -f "$d" ] && phpunit -c "$d" || true; done

pinned-dependencies.automattic/vipwpcs: Held at 3.0.* because there is no committed lockfile: CI resolves this constraint fresh on every run, so a new minor lands in every open PR at once. 3.1.0 broadens NoPaging (posts_per_page/numberposts set to -1), FetchingRemoteData and AlwaysReturnInFilter, which flags pre-existing call sites in nearly every plugin. Adopting it means triaging those findings, so it belongs in its own PR rather than arriving unannounced.
